summary: The Allegheny County library system argues that the E-Rate program is essential for maintaining library services and the financial savings it provides. They express concern that limiting or sunsetting the program would result in the loss of over $800,000 annually in internet access savings.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate funding, libraries will lose over $800,000 annual savings on internet access
claims.evidence_quote: Without the E-Rate funding, our libraries will lose out on the over $800,000 annual savings on internet access.

filer_raw: Allegheny County Library Association | Amy Anderson
